text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, bivalirudin is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale General holds 136 vials of the 250 mg injection with 12.7 days on hand. Corvale East holds 270 vials with 30.8 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include bivalirudin as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply at Corvale General is below the preferred threshold. The rule‑based best option is Accord Healthcare, Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today. However, Accord's label names no plant we could place, so the manufacturing site cannot be verified from the label. A Dr. Reddy's label lists Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) as a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2024-07-25. We must confirm whether the Accord product can be sourced from a registered facility with an acceptable inspection history before purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies Accord Healthcare's manufacturing site registration and inspection history; buyer approves if acceptable.
2. If Accord verification fails, buyer evaluates Avenacy, LLC, Civica, Inc., Eugia US LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC for site registration and inspection history; buyer approves acceptable source.
3. Pharmacy director approves the final purchase order for the selected vendor.
4. P&T committee acknowledges the procurement plan at the next scheduled meeting.

Not recommended: Purchasing from any supplier without confirming a registered manufacturing facility with an acceptable FDA inspection history.
